messages:
ashley: Heads-up — planning the go/no-go sync for v1.8. Target cut date: Mon May 3. Proposing Wed Apr 28 16:00 PT for the final decision meeting. Need eng leads + PM + infra. Who can make it?

mike: I can do Wed 16:00 PT. +1 to run the agenda below.

lee: I have a conflict 16:00–17:00. Could do 15:00 PT or join via phone for the last 15m.

sara: FYI I'll be on PTO Apr 28 afternoon. Can deputize @jonathan to run QA checklist and share results before the meeting.

jonathan: Confirming I'm the release owner — will be there. Proposed agenda (short):
```
Agenda (25m):
- Quick status & rollover (5m) — release owner
- Open/blocking bugs (8m) — eng leads
- Infra/capacity + canary plan (5m) — ops
- Cut criteria & rollback conditions (4m) — PM/eng
- Sign-off & next steps (3m)
```

ashley: Please add code-freeze sanity and e2e pass rate to cut criteria. Suggested thresholds: 98% unit + 95% e2e, no Sev1 regressions.

mike: Noted. Also double-check DB migration backout plan. If migration present, include migration owner in attendees.

release-manager-bot: calendar event created: "v1.8 go/no-go" Wed Apr 28 16:00 PT — https://calendar.company/release/v1.8  Attendees: ashley, mike, jonathan, lee (tentative), sara (declined)

ashley: RSVP tracker (reply here with yes/maybe/no):
- @ashley: yes
- @mike: yes
- @lee: maybe (can join final 15m)
- @sara: no (PTO) — will send notes
- @jonathan: yes

lee: maybe -> will try to hop in at 16:15 PT.

ashley: Action items before Wed: 
- jonathan: post latest bug list and test pass rates by Tue EOD. (please include link to failing tests)
- mike: confirm DB migration backout steps and owner.
- ashley: prepare cut checklist + post meeting doc template.
- ops (cc @release-manager-bot): validate canary capacity and smoke script.

jonathan: Will post bug list now: https://internal-issues/release/v1.8/blocks  (summary below)
- 3 regressing UI sevs (in progress)
- 1 flaky e2e (flaky-auth)
- 2 perf regressions on long tails

ashley: Quick meeting doc template (please copy into release doc):
```
Go/No-Go — v1.8 (Wed Apr 28 16:00 PT)
- Participants: 
- Quick status (owner)
- Blockers + ETA (owners)
- Infra/canary readiness (ops)
- Cut criteria check (QA/PM)
- Final decision: GO / HOLD / ROLLBACK PLAN
- Action items (who/when)
```

ashley: For ops canary smoke: run `./scripts/canary-smoke.sh --env=staging --iterations=50` — want pass rate >= 98% before cut.

mike: DB rollback snippet I reviewed: ```sql
-- rollback example
ALTER TABLE users DROP COLUMN new_flag; -- backout step
```
I'll confirm owner and add to doc.

jonathan: Posted bug list + e2e dashboard: https://dashboards.internal/release/v1.8
E2E pass rate 94.6% (baseline target 95%). I'll focus QA run tonight to get that up.

sara: Leaving detailed QA notes with @jonathan. If anything needs a decision while I'm out, mark me as "delegate: sara" in the doc.

ashley: If we hit >3 Sev2s or e2e <95% at Tue 18:00 PT, plan is to HOLD and reconvene Thur AM. Otherwise we'll cut on Mon.

release-manager-bot: Reminder scheduled — 24h before event and 1h before event.

mike: +1 to the hold threshold. I'll block DB owner to be on call Mon in case of rollback.

ashley: Thanks all — jonathan please ping this thread when bug list + pass rate are posted. I'll publish final agenda Tue morning. :thumbsup:
